titleEn: How Long Does a Kitchen Renovation Take in Vancouver? Real Timelines from 2026 Projects
titleZh: 温哥华厨房装修需要多长时间？2026年真实项目工期数据
contentEn:
A kitchen renovation in Vancouver in 2026 takes between 2 weeks and 10 weeks, depending on scope, material lead times, and whether your project requires a City of Vancouver building permit. The fastest 聚星裝修 projects completed in as little as 2 to 3 weeks. The longest ran 8 to 10 weeks. This guide breaks down what drives each phase and how homeowners can keep their project on schedule.

What Determines Kitchen Renovation Duration in Vancouver?

Three factors most commonly extend a kitchen renovation timeline in Metro Vancouver:

  • Permit requirements. Moving plumbing, altering electrical circuits, or removing a load-bearing wall requires a City of Vancouver building permit, adding 2 to 4 weeks to the approval timeline.
  • Material lead times. Custom cabinetry requires 3 to 6 weeks to manufacture after measurements are confirmed. Imported stone countertops add another 1 to 3 weeks.
  • Scope complexity. A cosmetic refresh takes 2 to 4 weeks. A full reconfiguration typically requires 6 to 10 weeks of active site work.

Kitchen Renovation Timeline by Scope (2026 Data)

Timelines are drawn from 聚星裝修 projects completed in Greater Vancouver in 2026. They do not include planning and permitting, which adds 2 to 6 weeks upfront.

Cosmetic Kitchen Refresh: 2-4 Weeks

Replaces cabinet fronts, updates hardware, repaints walls, and installs new light fixtures without altering plumbing or electrical rough-ins. 聚星裝修 completed a Richmond condo kitchen refresh in 2 to 3 weeks, one of the fastest kitchen projects of 2026.

Standard Kitchen Renovation: 3-6 Weeks

Updates the layout without moving major plumbing or electrical runs. 聚星裝修 2026 project data shows minimalist Richmond kitchens at 3-4 weeks; Surrey custom cabinet kitchens at 4-5 weeks; Burnaby custom kitchens at 4-6 weeks; Coquitlam kitchens at 5-6 weeks.

Full Kitchen Reconfiguration: 6-10 Weeks

Moves the sink, adds electrical outlets, installs new lighting circuits, and may involve cabinetry spanning multiple walls or including an island. 聚星裝修 completed a White Shaker kitchen in Vancouver in 8 to 10 weeks.

The 6-Phase Kitchen Renovation Process in Vancouver

  1. Discovery and design (1-3 weeks). Initial consultation, measurements, material selection, scope confirmation. Strata approval obtained if applicable.
  2. Permit application (2-4 weeks). 聚星裝修 prepares and submits drawings for City of Vancouver building permits.
  3. Demolition (3-5 days). Removal of existing cabinets, countertops, flooring, and damaged wall substrate.
  4. Rough-in (3-7 days). Electrical and plumbing rough-in after demolition and before walls are closed.
  5. Installation (5-14 days). Cabinets, countertops, tile, backsplash, and fixtures installed.
  6. Completion (2-5 days). Final adjustments, painting, hardware, and 聚星裝修 project manager walkthrough.

How to Stay on Schedule

  • Lock in material selections early. Choosing hardware, faucet finish, and countertop material before permits are submitted prevents mid-project delays.
  • Obtain strata approval before permit application. In condos and townhouses, strata approval is required before a building permit application can be submitted. Parallel processing saves 2 to 3 weeks.
  • Prepare for living without a kitchen. A full reconfiguration requires a temporary kitchen setup for the duration of active work.

Frequently Asked Questions About Kitchen Renovation Timelines in Vancouver

How long does a small kitchen renovation take in Vancouver?

A cosmetic kitchen renovation takes 2 to 4 weeks for active construction, assuming no permit is required and materials are in stock.

Does a kitchen renovation require a permit in Vancouver?

Moving plumbing, adding electrical circuits, or altering walls always requires a City of Vancouver building permit. Condos and townhouses also require strata approval before work begins.

What is the longest phase of a kitchen renovation?

Custom cabinetry lead time is typically the longest non-permit phase: 3 to 6 weeks after final measurements are confirmed.

Can a kitchen renovation be done in stages?

Yes. 聚星裝修 has completed staged renovations where cosmetic updates were done first, followed by a second phase involving plumbing and electrical work with a permit.

What affects kitchen renovation timeline most in Vancouver?

Three factors most commonly extend timelines: permit approval delays (adds 2-4 weeks), custom cabinetry lead times (3-6 weeks), and unforeseen conditions discovered during demolition.

contentZh:
2026年大温哥华地区的厨房装修工期取决于工程范围、材料交货时间和许可证申请要求。最快的项目可在2至3周内完工。最长的项目需要8至10周。本文详细解析各阶段工期影响因素，以及房主如何确保项目按时完成。

温哥华厨房装修工期的决定因素

大温哥华厨房装修工期延长的三个最常见因素：

  • 许可证要求。 移动管道、改造电路或拆除承重墙需要温哥华市建筑许可证，审批时间增加2至4周。
  • 材料交货时间。 定制橱柜通常需要3至6周生产时间。进口石材台面再加1至3周。
  • 工程复杂度。 外观翻新需2至4周。全面改造通常需要6至10周现场施工。

按工程范围划分的厨房装修工期（2026年数据）

以下工期数据来源于聚星裝修2026年在大温哥华地区完成的项目，仅含现场施工时间，不含规划和许可阶段（额外增加2至6周）。

外观厨房翻新：2-4周

外观翻新更换橱柜门板、更新五金件、重新粉刷墙壁并安装新灯具。聚星裝修2026年最快的厨房项目之一——列治文公寓外观翻新在2至3周内完工。

标准厨房装修：3-6周

标准装修在不大幅移动主要管道的情况下更新布局。聚星裝修2026年项目数据显示：列治文极简风格厨房翻新3至4周；高贵静厨房翻新5至6周。

全面厨房改造：6-10周

全面改造移动水槽位置、增设电源插座、安装新照明电路。聚星裝修完成的温哥华白宫橱柜厨房翻新耗时8至10周。

温哥华厨房装修六阶段流程

  1. 设计规划（1-3周）。 初步咨询、现场测量、材料选择和工程范围确认。
  2. 许可证申请（2-4周）。 准备并提交图纸。
  3. 拆除（3-5天）。 拆除现有橱柜、台面、地板。
  4. 隐蔽工程（3-7天）。 电路和管道预埋工程在拆除后、墙体封闭前进行。
  5. 安装（5-14天）。 橱柜、台面、瓷砖、背板和固定装置安装。
  6. 完工验收（2-5天）。 最终调整、刷漆，五金安装，以及验收巡查。

房主如何确保工期不延误

  • 尽早锁定材料选择。 在提交许可证申请前确定橱柜五金件、水龙头款式和台面材料，可避免施工中途更换导致的延误。
  • 在许可证申请前获得业主委员会批准。 公寓和联排别墅需要先获得业主委员会批准才能提交建筑许可证申请。
  • 做好无厨房生活的准备。 全面改造需要房主在整个施工期间设置临时厨房。

关于温哥华厨房装修工期的常见问题

温哥华小型厨房装修需要多长时间？

温哥华小型或外观厨房装修现场施工阶段需要2至4周，前提是无需许可证且材料有现货。

温哥华厨房装修需要许可证吗？

移动管道、增加电路或改动墙壁始终需要温哥华市建筑许可证。公寓和联排别墅开工前还需要业主委员会批准。

厨房装修哪个阶段最长？

定制橱柜的材料交货时间通常是非许可证阶段中最长的，需要3至6周生产时间。

厨房装修可以分阶段进行吗？

可以。聚星裝修完成过分期装修案例，第一阶段先做外观更新，第二阶段再进行管道和电路改造并申请许可证。

什么因素对温哥华厨房装修工期影响最大？

三个因素最常见地导致工期延长：许可证审批延误（增加2至4周）、定制橱柜材料交货时间（3至6周），以及拆除期间发现的意外情况。
